Reported Crop Circles for the State of California -

Lemon Grove, San Diego County (November 16, 1973)

An approximately 20’ diameter circle in grass swirled counter-clockwise is reportedly found by an 11-year-old boy around 7 p.m. after witnessing a glowing red “structured craft” on the ground take off and fly away.

Eyewitness report only.

Crop type: Grass

Source: The Secret History of Crop Circles, Terry Wilson
